The [[Chadra-Fan religion|religion]] of the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was based around a '''deity''' that was said to live at the bottom of the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] on the Chadra-Fan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Chad/Legends|Chad]]. The [[Deity/Legends|deity]] controlled the seas and supposedly used His tail to create [[Tsunami/Legends|tsunamis]] when He was angry at the Chadra-Fan. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the religion was ancient and known to all Chadra-Fan, although few still believed in the deity.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
The deity was mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a [[2014]] sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' module [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
